question: What share of a lead-acid cell's mass is lead or lead oxide, what share of a Li-ion cell's weight is active cathode material, and how many times larger is the first?

trace.query: SELECT id, page, text, strength FROM atoms WHERE regexp_matches(lower(text), 'lead|cathode|weight|mass|%') ORDER BY page, id
SELECT id, text FROM atoms WHERE id IN ('p3.L22','p3.L23','p3.L47','p3.L48','p3.L49','p3.L50') OR (page=3 AND id LIKE 'p3.L4%') ORDER BY id
SELECT CAST(regexp_extract((SELECT text FROM atoms WHERE id='p3.L22'),'(\d+)%',1) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(regexp_extract((SELECT text FROM atoms WHERE id='p3.L49'),'(\d+)%',1) AS DOUBLE) AS ratio
